literal.prompt: Какой отдел головного мозга играет ключевую роль в регуляции температуры тела?

literalGroups.primaryGround: The prompt asks which brain region plays the central role in body-temperature regulation. Endotext places thermoregulation among hypothalamic homeostatic functions and describes hypothalamic heat sensing and temperature-set-point pathways (L321, L974, L1003). NIMH confirms the distractors are real brain regions with distinct non-temperature functions: cerebellum balance/coordination (L27), frontal lobe complex thought/learning/problem-solving (L21), and occipital lobe visual processing (L25). Thus only hypothalamus fits the requested relation.
literalGroups.locator: https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/sites/books/NBK279126/, returned L321, L974, and L1003: hypothalamic regions participate in thermoregulation; heat sensors in the median preoptic hypothalamus project to centers controlling autonomic responses and temperature set-point regulation.
